entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_CORVETTE
entries.value:
Construct CORVETTE

Small, quick gunboat that carries a flak cannon to fend off carrier fighters. Good versus light-armored units.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard.
Main Weapon: Small laser turret.
Unique Weapon: Flak cannon.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_MISSILECRUISER
entries.value:
Construct MISSILE CRUISER

Medium gunboat that fires armor-piercing missiles, 4 to 8 in one salvo. Missile Pack (1-2) provides more missiles; Cloaking allows it to cloak itself (both researched at Ballistics Lab). Good vs. heavy-armored units.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard, Ballistics Lab.
Main Weapon: Missiles. Special Ability: Cloaking.
Armor: Light.

entries.value:
Construct LASER TURRET 
Floats in space.

Defensive gun platform that fires laser bolts. Automatically attacks enemy units.

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TANKER
entries.value:
Construct HARVESTER 

Harvests ore from asteroid and debris fields and gas from nebulae. Increase its holding capacity by researching Harvester (lvl 1-2) at Refinery.

Unit Dependency: Refinery.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TROOPSHIP
entries.value:
Construct TROOPSHIP

Carries troops to infiltrate construction ships, harvesting ships, and platforms (not gunboats). Research Troopship (lvl 1-3) at Marine Training Facility to take over more heavily armored units.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard, Marine Training Facility.
Main Weapon: Troops.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_REFINERY
entries.value:
Construct REFINERY
Requires 2 slots.

Harvests ore/gas. Builds Harvesters; researches Supply (lvl 1-4), Harvester (lvl 1-2), Resupply (lvl 1-2), Ore (lvl 1-2), Gas (lvl 1-2).

Unit Dependency: Headquarters. Required for: Light Shipyard, Supply Platform, Jump Gate.
Storage Capacity: 1000 ore; 500 gas. Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LIGHTIND
entries.value:
Construct LIGHT SHIPYARD
Requires 3 slots.

Builds Corvettes, Missile Cruisers, Troopships, Infiltrators.

Unit Dependency: Refinery.
Required for: Ballistics Lab.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FIELD_PLASMA
entries.value:
PLASMA NEBULA 
Cloud that contains the standard dust and gas but also large solid plasma particles. 
 
ADVANTAGE: Amplifies shielding on all units within.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FIELD_ASTEROID_SML
entries.value:
SMALL ASTEROID FIELD
A field of small metallic asteroids and moon dust. Contains small nuggets of ore for harvesting.  Units slow down while navigating the field.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FLEETCARRIER
entries.value:
Construct FLEET CARRIER

Large ship that deploys 2 wings of fighters (6 ships per wing) for long-range attacks. Vulnerable to close-range attacks.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard, Squadron Hangar.
Main Weapon: Fighter wings.
Special Weapon: Probe.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_BATTLESHIP
entries.value:
Construct BATTLESHIP 

Large ship that has 2 double-barrel turrets, each firing a twin laser bolt of destruction.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard.
Main Weapon: 2 double-barrel heavy laser turrets.
Special Weapon: Tempest Charge.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SPACESTATION
entries.value:
Construct SPACE STATION
Floats in space.

Defensive platform that launches 1 fighter wing. Automatically attacks enemy units.

Unit Dependency: Squadron Hangar.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_DREADNOUGHT
entries.value:
Construct DREADNOUGHT

Large ship that unleashes massive damage from 3 cannons that fire large laser bolts. Most powerful ship of Terran forces.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard, Propulsion Lab, AWS Research Lab.
Main Weapon: 3 triple-barrel heavy laser turrets. 
Special Weapon: Aegis Shield.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_INFILTRATOR
entries.value:
Construct INFILTRATOR

Small ship with excellent speed and large sensor radius. Can ping system to track down units. Cloaking (researched at Ballistics Lab) allows it to cloak itself. Excellent for recon in unexplored systems.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard, LR Sensor Tower.
Main Weapon: None. Special Ability: Cloaking, Ping.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LANCERCRUISER
entries.value:
Construct LANCER CRUISER 

Medium ship with multitargeting ARC cannon that fires ionized electrical beam that arcs off one target onto nearby units.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard, Propulsion Lab, Displacement Lab, Naval Academy.
Main Weapon: ARC cannon (3 max.).
Special Weapon: Vampire Arc.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SUPPLYSHIP
entries.value:
Construct SUPPLYSHIP

Resupplies ships within limited radius.

Unit Dependency: Headquarters, Supply Platform.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FABRICATOR
entries.value:
Construct FABRICATOR

Only Terran ship that can build and repair platforms as well as salvage platforms. The salvage value is 50% of the total cost of the platform.

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_ADVFABRICATOR
entries.value:
ADVANCED FABRICATOR 
Construction ship that can build all of your more advanced facilities 
 
Advantages: Builds advanced structures and can salvage or repair any structure 
Disadvantages: No weapons or defenses

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FLEETADMIRAL
entries.value:
FLEET ADMIRAL 
Officers that command the fleets to which you assign them. Trained in the art of tactics and warfare, admirals will effectively control and provide bonuses to the fleet..

Unit Dependency: Naval Academy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SUPPLYDEPOT
entries.value:
Construct SUPPLY PLATFORM
Requires 2 slots.

Resupplies ships and gun platforms, as well as those of allies, within limited radius.

Unit Dependency: Refinery.
Required for: Repair Platform, Supplyship, Supply Upgrades (lvl 1-4), Resupply Upgrades (lvl 1-2).
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_OUTPOST
entries.value:
Construct MARINE TRAINING FACILITY
Requires 2 slots.

Recruits crew from earth and swamp planets. Researches Troopship Upgrades (lvl 1-3).

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Required for: Naval Academy, Troopship.
Storage Capacity: 200 crew.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LASERTURRET
entries.value:
Construct LASER TURRET 
Floats in space.

Defensive gun platform that fires laser bolts. Automatically attacks enemy units.

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_NAVALACADEMY
entries.value:
Construct NAVAL ACADEMY
Requires 2 slots.

Recruits crew faster than Marine Training Facility. 
(Builds Admirals Halsey, Hawkes, Benson, Smirnoff, Steele, Takei in Quick Battle and Multiplayer Games).

Unit Dependency: Marine Training Facility. 
Required for: Squadron Hangar, Troopship Upgrades (lvl 2-3). 
Storage Capacity: 350 crew; Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_MRSENSOR
entries.value:
LR SENSOR TOWER 
\Increases line of sight allowing for earlier detection of enemies.  Can also detect cloaked ships at a limited range.
Can upgrade a ship's Sensor Range (lvl 1-2) (Sensor Range lvl 2 is dependent on the AWS Research Lab).
Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Required for the Infiltrator.
Offers 10 Command Points.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_ADVHULL
entries.value:
Construct ADVANCED HULL FACTORY
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Hull Upgrades (lvl 1-4) to increase the hulls of all ships and platforms.

Unit Dependency: Ballistics Lab.
Required for: Heavy Shipyard, Displacement Lab, Propulsion Lab.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PROPLAB
entries.value:
Construct PROPULSION LAB
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Engine (lvl 1-4) to increase speed of all ships.

Unit Dependency: Advanced Hull Factory.
Required for: Lancer Cruiser, Dreadnought.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_REPAIRDEPOT
entries.value:
Construct REPAIR PLATFORM
Requires 2 slots.

Resupplies and repairs ships, as well as those of allies, within limited radius. Gun platforms can be resupplied by this platform, but not repaired.

Unit Dependency: Supply Platform.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HEAVYIND
entries.value:
Construct HEAVY SHIPYARD
Requires 3 slots.

Builds Battleships, Fleet Carriers, Lancer Cruisers, Dreadnoughts.

Unit Dependency: Advanced Hull Factory.
Required for: AWS Research Lab.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_AWSLAB
entries.value:
Construct AWS RESEARCH LAB
Requires 2 slots.

Researches Tempest Charge, Probe, Vampire Arc, Aegis Shield.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard.
Required for: Ion Cannon, Dreadnought, Weapon Upgrades (lvl 3-4), Engine Upgrades (lvl 3-4), Hull Upgrades (lvl 3-4), Shield Upgrades (lvl 3-4), Sensor Upgrades (lvl 2), Fighter Wing Upgrade (lvl 3). Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_DEFENSEBATTERY
entries.value:
FIGHTER DEFENSE BATTERY 
Stationary defense batteries that can be used to protect against fighter attack. 
 
USE: Only protects against enemy fighters

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LRSENSOR
entries.value:
Construct LR SENSOR TOWER
Requires 1 slot.

Offers 10 command points. Clears fog of war and detects ships at long range. Researches Sensor (lvl 1-2).

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Required for: Infiltrator.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LOGISTICS
entries.value:
LOGISTICS CENTER 
This facility produces advanced components for resupply technology. 
 
USE: Allows HEAVY SHIPYARD to produce SUPPLY SHIPS

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_NANOMETAL
entries.value:
NANOMETALS LAB 
Research lab that allows for advancements in armor and supply technologies. 
 
USE: Research for HULL and SUPPLY upgrades

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TECHIND
entries.value:
TECH INDUSTRIAL 
Secretive or highly advanced units are produced here depending on the available credits. 
 
USE: Constructs the most technically advanced Terran vessels

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FORCEWAVE
entries.value:
FORCE-WAVE LAB 
This Lab allows for the study of force shielding and energy emmissions technology. 
 
USE: Upgrades for the WEAPONS and SHIELDS are done here

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FIELD_ANTIMATTER
entries.value:
ANTIMATTER RIBBON 

An impassable wall of energy. Ships must navigate around this ribbon.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HQ
entries.value:
Construct HEADQUARTERS 
Requires 3 slots.
Used to create Fabricators and Supplyships. This platform can supply all ships within a limited radius.
Unit Dependency: None. Required for the  Refinery, Marine Training Facility, LR Sensor Tower, and Laser Turret.
Offers 25 Command Points.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_BALLISTICSLAB
entries.value:
Construct BALLISTICS LAB
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Weapon Upgrades (lvl 1-2) for all gunboats and Missile Pack Upgrades (lvl 1-2) for Missile Cruisers. Also researches Cloaking for the Infiltrator and Missile Cruiser.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard.
Required for: Advanced Hull Factory, Missile Cruiser.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TENDER
entries.value:
Construct SUPPLY PLATFORM 
Requires 2 slots.

Resupplies gunboats and defense platforms within a limited radius that can be upgraded at the Refinery.

Unit Dependency: Refinery.
Required for: Repair Platform, Supplyship, Supply Upgrades (lvl 1-4), and Resupply Upgrades (lvl 1-2).
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HANGER
entries.value:
Construct SQUADRON HANGAR
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Fighter Wing (lvl 1-3).

Unit Dependency: Naval Academy.
Required for: Space Station, Fleet Carrier.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SENSORTOWER
entries.value:
SENSOR TOWER 
This platform will give you the opportunity to upgrade the sensor radius of all your units. 
 Offers 10 Command Points.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_DISPLACEMENTLAB
entries.value:
Construct DISPLACEMENT LAB 
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Shield (lvl 1-4) to increase shields of ships, except Infiltrator.

Unit Dependency: Advanced Hull Factory.
Required for: Lancer Cruiser.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_IONCANNON
entries.value:
Construct ION CANNON 
Floats in space.

Defensive platform that fires a large plasma bolt. Causes heavy damage at long range. Automatically attacks enemy units.

Unit Dependency: AWS Research Lab.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HVYREFINERY
entries.value:
HEAVY REFINERY 
This platform is an upgrade from the regular refinery. 
This platform will give you the opportunity to upgrade your Harvester

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_COCOON
entries.value:
Construct COCOON
Requires 3 slots.

Offers 25 command points. Resupplies ships and gun platforms within limited radius. Builds Weavers and Zoraps.

Unit Dependency: None.
Required for: Collector, Eye Stalk.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_COLLECTOR
entries.value:
Construct COLLECTOR
Requires 3 slots.

Harvests ore/gas; recruits crew. Builds Siphons; researches Siphon (lvl 1-3), Supply (lvl 1-3), Resupply (lvl 1-3). 

Unit Dependency: Cocoon.
Required for: Thripid, Warlord Training Grounds, Jump Gate, Greater Collector evolution. Storage Capacity: 1500 ore, 750 gas, 100 crew. Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_GRCOLLECTOR
entries.value:
GREATER COLLECTOR
Takes up 3 slots.
Used to harvest Ore, Gas, and Crew from planets at a higher rate than the Collector.  Can build Siphons and can upgrade Supply capacity (lvl 1-4), Plantation radius (lvl 1-3), and a Siphon's supply capacity (lvl 1-2).
Unit Dependency: Mutation Colony.
Storage capacity: 1500 Ore, 750 Gas and 100 Crew.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_JUMPGATE
entries.value:
Construct JUMP GATE

Constructed on Wormholes.  
Extends supply lines to the system that is connected by the wormhole. Also, prevents enemy ships from entering through a wormhole that has a jump gate.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_WARLORD
entries.value:
Construct WARLORD TRAINING GROUNDS
Requires 2 slots.

Recruits crew from earth and swamp planets. (Builds Warlords Mordella, Azkar, Ver Lak, Ker Tak, Thripid, Malkor in Quick Battle and Multiplayer Games). Researches Leech (1-2).

Unit Dependency: Collector.
Required for: Niad, Carrion Roost, Plasma Spitter.
Storage Capacity: 1000 Crew; Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_THRIPID
entries.value:
Construct THRIPID
Requires 3 slots.

Builds Scout Carriers, Frigates, Khamirs, Hive Carriers, Seekers.

Unit Dependency: Collector.
Required for: Plantation, Blast Furnace, Niad evolution.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_NIAD
entries.value:
NIAD
Takes up 3 slots.
Used to build the Scout Carrier, Frigate, Khamir, Hive Carrier, Seeker, Leech, Spinelayer, Scarab, and Tiamat.
Unit Dependency: Warlord Training Grounds.
Required for: Bio Forge and Mutation Colony.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PLANTATION
entries.value:
Construct PLANTATION
Requires 2 slots.

Resupplies ships and gun platforms within limited radius.

Unit Dependency: Thripid.
Required for: Dissection Chamber, Zorap, Greater Plantation evolution, Supply Upgrades (lvl 1-3), Resupply Upgrades (lvl 1-3).
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_DISSECTION
entries.value:
Construct DISSECTION CHAMBER
Requires 2 slots.

Salvages ships for 100% original investment.

Unit Dependency: Plantation.
Required for: Tiamat.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_BLASTFURNACE
entries.value:
Construct BLAST FURNACE
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Weapon (lvl 1-2).

Unit Dependency: Thripid.
Required for: Frigate, Khamir, Explosives Range evolution.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_EXPLORANGE
entries.value:
EXPLOSIVES RANGE
Takes up 1 slot.
Used to research Weapon Upgrades (lvl1- 3) and the Explosive Ram Upgrades (lvl 1-2).
Unit Dependency: Thripid.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_EYESTALK
entries.value:
Construct EYE STALK
Requires 2 slots.

Offers 15 command points. Clears fog of war and detects ships at long range. Researches Sensor (lvl 1-3). 

Unit Dependency: Cocoon.
Required for: Seeker, Mutation Colony evolution.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_BIOFORGE
entries.value:
Construct BIO FORGE
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Shield (lvl 1-2) to increase shields of ships. 

Unit Dependency: Niad.
Required for: Tiamat, Fusion Mill evolution, Carapace Plant evolution.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FUSIONMILL
entries.value:
FUSION MILL
Takes up 1 slot.
Used to research Engine Upgrades (lvl 1-2) to increase all ships' speed.
Can evolve into the Hybrid Center.
Unit Dependency: Bio Forge.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_CARAPACE
entries.value:
CARAPACE PLANT
Takes up 1 slot.
Used to research Hull Upgrades (lvl 1-2) to increase the hull of all ships and platforms, except the Seeker.
Can evolve into the Hybrid Center.
Unit Dependency: Bio Forge.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HYBRID
entries.value:
HYBRID CENTER
Takes up 1 slot.
Used to upgrade speed, shield, and hull of all ships by researching Engine Upgrades (lvl 3), Shield Upgrades (lvl 3), and Hull Upgrades (lvl 3) .
Unit Dependency: Fusion Mill or the Carapace Plant.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_CARRIONROOST
entries.value:
Construct CARRION ROOST
Requires 2 slots.

Researches Fighter Wing (lvl 1-5) to increase fighter accuracy to enemies.

Unit Dependency: Warlord Training Grounds.
Required for: Plasma Hive, Hive Carrier, Tiamat.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PLASMASPITTER
entries.value:
Construct PLASMA SPITTER
Floats in space.

Defensive platform that fires a small plasma bolt. Automatically attacks enemy units. 

Unit Dependency: Warlord Training Grounds.
Required for: Plasma Hive evolution, Voraak Cannon evolution.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PLASMAHIVE
entries.value:
PLASMA HIVE

Constructed in space.
Defensive platform that launches wings of fighters for long range attacks. Automatically attacks enemy ships and platforms.
Unit Dependency: Carrion Roost and Plasma Spitter.
Armor: Medium .

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_VORAAK
entries.value:
VORAAK CANNON

Constructed in space.
Defensive platform that fires a large plasma bolt. Automatically attacks enemy ships and platforms. 
Causes heavy damage at long range.
Unit Dependency: Mutation Colony and Plasma Spitter.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_WEEVER
entries.value:
Construct WEAVER

Only Mantis ship that can build and repair platforms as well as salvage platforms. The salvage value is 50% of the total cost of the platform.

Unit Dependency: Cocoon.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_ZORAP
entries.value:
Construct ZORAP

Resupplies ships within limited radius.

Unit Dependency: Cocoon, Collector, Plantation.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SIPHON
entries.value:
Construct SIPHON

Harvests ore from asteroid and debris fields and gas from nebulae. Increase its holding capacity by researching Siphon (lvl 1-3) at Collector. 

Unit Dependency: Collector.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FRIGATE
entries.value:
Construct FRIGATE

Small, fast gunboat that fires twin laser blasts from its front turrets. Good for scouting and in close battles, but weak against larger ships.

Unit Dependency: Thripid, Blast Furnace.
Main Weapon: Twin laser turrets.
Special Ability: Mimic.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SCOUTCARRIER
entries.value:
Construct SCOUT CARRIER

Medium ship that launches attack fighters to attack enemies from short- to medium-range distance. Good against light-armored units.

Unit Dependency: Thripid.
Main Weapon: 1 squad of light attack fighters.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_KHAMIR
entries.value:
Construct KHAMIR

Small ship with excellent speed that fires a single laser dart.

Unit Dependency: Thripid, Blast Furnace.
Main Weapon: Single action dart laser.
Special Ability: Explosive Ram.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SPINELAYER
entries.value:
Construct SPINELAYER

Small ship with medium speed that drops mines for defensive purposes.

Unit Dependency: Niad, Explosives Range.
Main Weapon: None.
Special Ability: Cloaked mines.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LEECH
entries.value:
Construct LEECH

Carries troops to infiltrate construction ships, harvesting ships, and platforms (not gunboats). Research Leech (lvl 1-2) at Warlord Training Grounds to take over more heavily armored units. 

Unit Dependency: Niad, Hybrid Center.
Main Weapon: None.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HIVECARRIER
entries.value:
Construct HIVE CARRIER

Large ship with medium speed that launches 2 squads of attack fighters from medium- to long-range distance.

Unit Dependency: Thripid, Carrion Roost.
Main Weapon: 2 squads of medium attack fighters.
Special Weapon: Repellent Cloud.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SCARAB
entries.value:
Construct SCARAB

Large ship that fires plasma bolts from its twin plasma launchers. Provides excellent protection for long-range attack fighters.

Unit Dependency: Niad, Carapace Plant.
Main Weapon: Twin plasma launchers.
Special Weapon: Gravity Well.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TIAMAT
entries.value:
Construct TIAMAT

Large ship that unleashes devastating damage from its 3 squads of heavy attack fighters launched from long range.

Unit Dependency: Niad, Carrion Roost, Bio Forge, Dissection Chamber.
Main Weapon: 3 squads of heavy attack fighters.
Special Weapon: Repulsor Wave.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_CREW
entries.value: The Crew indicator shows how much crew you have available / maximum crew storage available.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_DEFEND
entries.value: DEFENSIVE orders selected units to stay and defend the immediate area.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_STAND
entries.value: STAND GROUND orders selected units to defend their current location.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_IDLE
entries.value: IDLE disables auto-targeting and auto-movement for selected units.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_STOP
entries.value: STOP cancels the current action for selected units.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_PATROL
entries.value: PATROL orders selected units to patrol an area that you determine.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_ESCORT
entries.value: ESCORT orders selected units to escort or defend a ship or platform.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_GOTO
entries.value: GO TO centers selected units on your main screen.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_SELL
entries.value: SALVAGE A PLATFORM dismantles any platform you choose and returns 50% of the platform's value.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUTTON_RALLY

entries.name: IDS_HINT_TEXT_ORE
entries.value: Ore is smelted to make the metals you need to build ships, platforms,and weaponry. It is found on earth planets and moons and in asteroid and debris fields. The hardware-happy Terrans have the greatest need for ore.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_TEXT_GAS

entries.name: IDS_HINT_TEXT_CREW
entries.value: Crew are the men and women who will do or die at your command.  They exist only on earth and swamp planets.   You need crew to run your ships. The carrier-reliant Mantis, who burn through drones like jet fuel, have the greatest need for crew.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_TEXT_CP

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_TEMPEST
entries.value:
TEMPEST CHARGE 

The Tempest Charge is the special weapon of the Battleship.  This special weapon is an area of effect weapon.  When fired it will cause damage to ships that are within the radius of the blast.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_PROBE
entries.value:
PROBE

The Probe is the special weapon of the Fleet Carrier. When the Probe is deployed it will clear the fog of war and reveal the entire system.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_VAMPIRE
entries.value:
VAMPIRE ARC 

The Vampire Arc is the special weapon of the Lancer Cruiser.  When fired,  the Lancer will be able to deplete the supplies of an enemy unit.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_AEGIS
entries.value:
AEGIS SHIELD 

The Aegis Shield is the special weapon of the Dreadnought.  When activated, the Dreadnought will become invincible to all enemy attacks.  The downside of this shield is the amount of supplies it costs to keep the shield activated.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_MIMIC
entries.value:
MIMIC

The Mimic is the special weapon of the Frigate.  When used, the Frigate is transformed into a replica of the targeted enemy ship. Can remain transformed until supplies are depleted.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_REPELLCLOUD
entries.value:
REPELLENT CLOUD

The Repellent Cloud is the special weapon of the Hive Carrier. When released, the cloud quickly spreads out causing damage to the hulls of ships caught in its path of destruction. Visibility is extremely limited until the cloud begins to dissipate.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_GRAVWELL
entries.value:
GRAVITY WELL

The Gravity Well is the special weapon of the Scarab.  When fired, a torpedo explodes immobilizing all ships caught within the fallout radius.  The ships are immobilized by a temporary gravity pull caused from the torpedo's blast.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_REPULSEWAVE
entries.value:
REPULSOR WAVE

The Repulsor Wave is the special weapon of the Tiamat.  When discharged, the Tiamat emits a wave of energy in order to keep its distance from enemy attacks.  This allows the Tiamat to effectively utilize its long-range heavy fighters while remaining a safe distance from enemy attackers.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_RAM
entries.value:
EXPLOSIVE RAM

The Explosive  Ram is the special weapon of the Khamir.  When the explosive ram is activated and a target is selected the Khamir will propell itself at a high velocity and explode upon impact causing heavy damage.  There are 2 levels to this special weapon.  Each level increases the amount of damage the Explosive Ram will cause.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_SYNTHESIS
entries.value:
SYNTHESIS
Used by the Taos, it merges into another ship, transferring its hull points to the targeted ship.  If you have a weakened ship that is more important, there would be a moment where the Taos will give the hit points it has and transfer them over to another ship.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_DISRUPTOR
entries.value:
MASS DISRUPTOR
This is the special weapon of the Polaris.  When this weapon hits an enemy unit, the enemy unit will lose 25% of its total hull points.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_SHROUD
entries.value:
SHROUD
The Shroud is the special weapon of the Aurora.  This special weapon will allow the Aurora and another ship invisible.  Only units that have cloak-detecting technology can see these ships (Infiltrator, Seeker, Oracle).To un-Shroud click on the Cloak icon.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_DESTABILIZE
entries.value:
DESTABILIZER TORPEDO
This weapon of the Trireme paralyzes a number of ships within a radius at which you fired. The affected ships will spin in an uncontrollable fashion and cannot be given orders until the effect wears off.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_AUGERRAY
entries.value:
AUGER RAY
This is a special weapon of the Monolith that causes massive damage to an enemy ship.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_CLOAKS
entries.value:
CLOAKING 

Cloaking is the special ability of the Aurora and Oracle.  This special ability will allow the Aurora and Oracle to become invisible.  Only units that have cloak-detecting technology can see these ships (Infiltrator, Seeker, Oracle).  Cloaking technology is only supply costing to the Aurora.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_ADMIRAL_FORMFLEET
entries.value:
FORM FLEET 
 
To form a fleet, select the fleet admiral and all
the units you want in a fleet, and then click the Form Fleet
button. A ship may only be in one fleet at a time. To select this
fleet, click the ship that the admiral is on, or click the Fleets hot
button to cycle through all your fleets. 
 
 A Fleet can be assigned to a function key (F1-F6) for quick access by first selecting your fleet and then [Ctrl] + a function key.

entries.value:

entries.name: IDS_HINT_ADMIRAL_RESUPPLY

entries.name: IDS_HINT_ADMIRAL_TRANSFER

 This the default formation.  Ships are grouped loosely.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_ASSAULT
entries.value:
STANDARD ASSAULT Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Light and Medium armored ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types that are not assigned to a group.

All ships within the formation will recieve a bonus to weapon damage and supplies.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_BLOCKADE
entries.value:
BLOCKADE Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Light and Medium armored ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types that are not assigned to a group.

All ships within the formation will recieve a bonus to sensors, weapon damage and defense.

All ships within the formation will also recieve a penalty bonus to speed, weapon range, supplies, and damage vs. platforms.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_CONVOY
entries.value:
CONVOY Formation 
 
 This formation consists of a main group. The The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types.

All ships within the formation will recieve a bonus to speed.

All ships within the formation will also recieve a penalty bonus to sensors, weapon range, weapon damage, defense, and supplies.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_HALSEY
entries.value:
HALSEY Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, battery groups, a recon group, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Medium and Heavy armored ships. The Battery group consists of carriers. The Recon group consists of light armored ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types that are not assigned to a group.

Battleships, Fleet Carriers, and Dreadnoughts within the formation will recieve a bonus to alltech.

All ships within the formation will also recieve a penalty bonus to sensors, weapon range, and supplies.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_LANCER
entries.value:
LANCER Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Short and Medium ranged ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types that are not assigned to a group.

Lancer Cruisers within the formation will recieve a bonus to weapon range, weapon damage, defense, damage vs. Light and Medium armored ships.

All ships within the formation will receive a penalty bonus to speed and supplies.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_PLANETDEF
entries.value:
PLANET DEFENSE Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Short and Medium ranged ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and long ranged ships. 
 
 This formation generates an AoE that buffs platforms. Platforms affected by this formation receive a bonus to defense. 
 
 All ships within the formation will receive a bonus to weapon damage and a penalty bonus to speed and supplies.

ION NEBULA 
Ships flying through or stationed in this nebula lose their shields. The nuggets are harvestable for gas resources.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_CORVETTE
entries.value:
Construct CORVETTE

Small, quick gunboat that carries a flak cannon to fend off carrier fighters. Good versus light-armored units.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard.
Main Weapon: Small laser turret.
Unique Weapon: Flak cannon.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_MISSILECRUISER
entries.value:
Construct MISSILE CRUISER

Medium gunboat that fires armor-piercing missiles, 4 to 8 in one salvo. Missile Pack (1-2) provides more missiles; Cloaking allows it to cloak itself (both researched at Ballistics Lab). Good vs. heavy-armored units.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard, Ballistics Lab.
Main Weapon: Missiles. Special Ability: Cloaking.
Armor: Light.

Construct LASER TURRET

Defensive gun platform that fires laser bolts. Automatically attacks enemy units.

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TANKER
entries.value:
Construct HARVESTER 

Harvests ore from asteroid and debris fields and gas from nebulae. Increase its holding capacity by researching Harvester (lvl 1-2) at Refinery.

Unit Dependency: Refinery.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TROOPSHIP
entries.value:
Construct TROOPSHIP

Carries troops to infiltrate construction ships, harvesting ships, and platforms (not gunboats). Research Troopship (lvl 1-3) at Marine Training Facility to take over more heavily armored units.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard, Marine Training Facility.
Main Weapon: Troops.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_REFINERY
entries.value:
Construct REFINERY
Requires 2 slots.

Harvests ore/gas. Builds Harvesters; researches Supply (lvl 1-4), Harvester (lvl 1-2), Resupply (lvl 1-2), Ore (lvl 1-2), Gas (lvl 1-2).

Unit Dependency: Headquarters. Required for: Light Shipyard, Supply Platform, Jump Gate.
Storage Capacity: 1000 ore; 500 gas. Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LIGHTIND
entries.value:
Construct LIGHT SHIPYARD
Requires 3 slots.

Builds Corvettes, Missile Cruisers, Troopships, Infiltrators.

Unit Dependency: Refinery.
Required for: Ballistics Lab.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FIELD_PLASMA
entries.value:
PLASMA NEBULA 
Cloud that contains the standard dust and gas but also large solid plasma particles. 
 
ADVANTAGE: Amplifies shielding on all units within.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FIELD_ASTEROID_SML
entries.value:
SMALL ASTEROID FIELD
A field of small metallic asteroids and moon dust. Contains small nuggets of ore for harvesting.  Units slow down while navigating the field.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FLEETCARRIER
entries.value:
Construct FLEET CARRIER

Large ship that deploys 2 wings of fighters (6 ships per wing) for long-range attacks. Vulnerable to close-range attacks.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard, Squadron Hangar.
Main Weapon: Fighter wings.
Special Weapon: Probe.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_BATTLESHIP
entries.value:
Construct BATTLESHIP 

Large ship that has 2 double-barrel turrets, each firing a twin laser bolt of destruction.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard.
Main Weapon: 2 double-barrel heavy laser turrets.
Special Weapon: Tempest Charge.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SPACESTATION
entries.value:
Construct SPACE STATION
Floats in space.

Defensive platform that launches 1 fighter wing. Automatically attacks enemy units.

Unit Dependency: Squadron Hangar.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_DREADNOUGHT
entries.value:
Construct DREADNOUGHT

Large ship that unleashes massive damage from 3 cannons that fire large laser bolts. Most powerful ship of Terran forces.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard, Propulsion Lab, AWS Research Lab.
Main Weapon: 3 triple-barrel heavy laser turrets. 
Special Weapon: Aegis Shield.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_INFILTRATOR
entries.value:
Construct INFILTRATOR

Small ship with excellent speed and large sensor radius. Can ping system to track down units. Cloaking (researched at Ballistics Lab) allows it to cloak itself. Excellent for recon in unexplored systems.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard, LR Sensor Tower.
Main Weapon: None. Special Ability: Cloaking, Ping.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LANCERCRUISER
entries.value:
Construct LANCER CRUISER 

Medium ship with multitargeting ARC cannon that fires ionized electrical beam that arcs off one target onto nearby units.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard, Propulsion Lab, Displacement Lab, Naval Academy.
Main Weapon: ARC cannon (3 max.).
Special Weapon: Vampire Arc.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SUPPLYSHIP
entries.value:
Construct SUPPLYSHIP

Resupplies ships within limited radius.

Unit Dependency: Headquarters, Supply Platform.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FABRICATOR
entries.value:
Construct FABRICATOR

Only Terran ship that can build and repair platforms as well as salvage platforms. The salvage value is 50% of the total cost of the platform.

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_ADVFABRICATOR
entries.value:
ADVANCED FABRICATOR 
Construction ship that can build all of your more advanced facilities 
 
Advantages: Builds advanced structures and can salvage or repair any structure 
Disadvantages: No weapons or defenses

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FLEETADMIRAL
entries.value:
FLEET ADMIRAL 
Officers that command the fleets to which you assign them. Trained in the art of tactics and warfare, admirals will effectively control and provide bonuses to the fleet..

Unit Dependency: Naval Academy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SUPPLYDEPOT
entries.value:
Construct SUPPLY PLATFORM
Requires 2 slots.

Resupplies ships and gun platforms, as well as those of allies, within limited radius.

Unit Dependency: Refinery.
Required for: Repair Platform, Supplyship, Supply Upgrades (lvl 1-4), Resupply Upgrades (lvl 1-2).
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_OUTPOST
entries.value:
Construct MARINE TRAINING FACILITY
Requires 2 slots.

Recruits crew from earth and swamp planets. Researches Troopship Upgrades (lvl 1-3).

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Required for: Naval Academy, Troopship.
Storage Capacity: 200 crew.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LASERTURRET
entries.value:
Construct LASER TURRET 
Floats in space.

Defensive gun platform that fires laser bolts. Automatically attacks enemy units.

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_NAVALACADEMY
entries.value:
Construct NAVAL ACADEMY
Requires 2 slots.

Recruits crew faster than Marine Training Facility. 
(Builds Admirals Halsey, Hawkes, Benson, Smirnoff, Steele, Takei in Quick Battle and Multiplayer Games).

Unit Dependency: Marine Training Facility. 
Required for: Squadron Hangar, Troopship Upgrades (lvl 2-3). 
Storage Capacity: 350 crew; Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_MRSENSOR
entries.value:
LR SENSOR TOWER 
\Increases line of sight allowing for earlier detection of enemies.  Can also detect cloaked ships at a limited range.
Can upgrade a ship's Sensor Range (lvl 1-2) (Sensor Range lvl 2 is dependent on the AWS Research Lab).
Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Required for the Infiltrator.
Offers 10 Command Points.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_ADVHULL
entries.value:
Construct ADVANCED HULL FACTORY
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Hull Upgrades (lvl 1-4) to increase the hulls of all ships and platforms.

Unit Dependency: Ballistics Lab.
Required for: Heavy Shipyard, Displacement Lab, Propulsion Lab.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PROPLAB
entries.value:
Construct PROPULSION LAB
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Engine (lvl 1-4) to increase speed of all ships.

Unit Dependency: Advanced Hull Factory.
Required for: Lancer Cruiser, Dreadnought.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_REPAIRDEPOT
entries.value:
Construct REPAIR PLATFORM
Requires 2 slots.

Resupplies and repairs ships, as well as those of allies, within limited radius. Gun platforms can be resupplied by this platform, but not repaired.

Unit Dependency: Supply Platform.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HEAVYIND
entries.value:
Construct HEAVY SHIPYARD
Requires 3 slots.

Builds Battleships, Fleet Carriers, Lancer Cruisers, Dreadnoughts.

Unit Dependency: Advanced Hull Factory.
Required for: AWS Research Lab.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_AWSLAB
entries.value:
Construct AWS RESEARCH LAB
Requires 2 slots.

Researches Tempest Charge, Probe, Vampire Arc, Aegis Shield.

Unit Dependency: Heavy Shipyard.
Required for: Ion Cannon, Dreadnought, Weapon Upgrades (lvl 3-4), Engine Upgrades (lvl 3-4), Hull Upgrades (lvl 3-4), Shield Upgrades (lvl 3-4), Sensor Upgrades (lvl 2), Fighter Wing Upgrade (lvl 3). Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_DEFENSEBATTERY
entries.value:
FIGHTER DEFENSE BATTERY 
Stationary defense batteries that can be used to protect against fighter attack. 
 
USE: Only protects against enemy fighters

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LRSENSOR
entries.value:
Construct LR SENSOR TOWER
Requires 1 slot.

Offers 10 command points. Clears fog of war and detects ships at long range. Researches Sensor (lvl 1-2).

Unit Dependency: Headquarters.
Required for: Infiltrator.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LOGISTICS
entries.value:
LOGISTICS CENTER 
This facility produces advanced components for resupply technology. 
 
USE: Allows HEAVY SHIPYARD to produce SUPPLY SHIPS

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_NANOMETAL
entries.value:
NANOMETALS LAB 
Research lab that allows for advancements in armor and supply technologies. 
 
USE: Research for HULL and SUPPLY upgrades

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TECHIND
entries.value:
TECH INDUSTRIAL 
Secretive or highly advanced units are produced here depending on the available credits. 
 
USE: Constructs the most technically advanced Terran vessels

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FORCEWAVE
entries.value:
FORCE-WAVE LAB 
This Lab allows for the study of force shielding and energy emmissions technology. 
 
USE: Upgrades for the WEAPONS and SHIELDS are done here

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FIELD_ANTIMATTER
entries.value:
ANTIMATTER RIBBON 

An impassable wall of energy. Ships must navigate around this ribbon.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HQ
entries.value:
Construct HEADQUARTERS 
Requires 3 slots.
Used to create Fabricators and Supplyships. This platform can supply all ships within a limited radius.
Unit Dependency: None. Required for the  Refinery, Marine Training Facility, LR Sensor Tower, and Laser Turret.
Offers 25 Command Points.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_BALLISTICSLAB
entries.value:
Construct BALLISTICS LAB
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Weapon Upgrades (lvl 1-2) for all gunboats and Missile Pack Upgrades (lvl 1-2) for Missile Cruisers. Also researches Cloaking for the Infiltrator and Missile Cruiser.

Unit Dependency: Light Shipyard.
Required for: Advanced Hull Factory, Missile Cruiser.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TENDER
entries.value:
Construct SUPPLY PLATFORM 
Requires 2 slots.

Resupplies gunboats and defense platforms within a limited radius that can be upgraded at the Refinery.

Unit Dependency: Refinery.
Required for: Repair Platform, Supplyship, Supply Upgrades (lvl 1-4), and Resupply Upgrades (lvl 1-2).
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HANGER
entries.value:
Construct SQUADRON HANGAR
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Fighter Wing (lvl 1-3).

Unit Dependency: Naval Academy.
Required for: Space Station, Fleet Carrier.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SENSORTOWER
entries.value:
SENSOR TOWER 
This platform will give you the opportunity to upgrade the sensor radius of all your units. 
 Offers 10 Command Points.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_DISPLACEMENTLAB
entries.value:
Construct DISPLACEMENT LAB

Researches Shield (lvl 1-4) to increase shields of ships, except Infiltrator.

Unit Dependency: Advanced Hull Factory.
Required for: Lancer Cruiser.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_IONCANNON
entries.value:
Construct ION CANNON 
Floats in space.

Defensive platform that fires a large plasma bolt. Causes heavy damage at long range. Automatically attacks enemy units.

Unit Dependency: AWS Research Lab.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HVYREFINERY
entries.value:
HEAVY REFINERY 
This platform is an upgrade from the regular refinery. 
This platform will give you the opportunity to upgrade your Harvester

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_COCOON
entries.value:
Construct COCOON
Requires 3 slots.

Offers 25 command points. Resupplies ships and gun platforms within limited radius. Builds Weavers and Zoraps.

Unit Dependency: None.
Required for: Collector, Eye Stalk.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_COLLECTOR
entries.value:
Construct COLLECTOR
Requires 3 slots.

Harvests ore/gas; recruits crew. Builds Siphons; researches Siphon (lvl 1-3), Supply (lvl 1-3), Resupply (lvl 1-3). 

Unit Dependency: Cocoon.
Required for: Thripid, Warlord Training Grounds, Jump Gate, Greater Collector evolution. Storage Capacity: 1500 ore, 750 gas, 100 crew. Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_GRCOLLECTOR
entries.value:
GREATER COLLECTOR
Takes up 3 slots.
Used to harvest Ore, Gas, and Crew from planets at a higher rate than the Collector.  Can build Siphons and can upgrade Supply capacity (lvl 1-4), Plantation radius (lvl 1-3), and a Siphon's supply capacity (lvl 1-2).
Unit Dependency: Mutation Colony.
Storage capacity: 1500 Ore, 750 Gas and 100 Crew.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_JUMPGATE
entries.value:
Construct JUMP GATE

Constructed on Wormholes.  
Extends supply lines to the system that is connected by the wormhole. Also, prevents enemy ships from entering through a wormhole that has a jump gate.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_WARLORD
entries.value:
Construct WARLORD TRAINING GROUNDS
Requires 2 slots.

Recruits crew from earth and swamp planets. (Builds Warlords Mordella, Azkar, Ver Lak, Ker Tak, Thripid, Malkor in Quick Battle and Multiplayer Games). Researches Leech (1-2).

Unit Dependency: Collector.
Required for: Niad, Carrion Roost, Plasma Spitter.
Storage Capacity: 1000 Crew; Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_THRIPID
entries.value:
Construct THRIPID
Requires 3 slots.

Builds Scout Carriers, Frigates, Khamirs, Hive Carriers, Seekers.

Unit Dependency: Collector.
Required for: Plantation, Blast Furnace, Niad evolution.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_NIAD
entries.value:
NIAD
Takes up 3 slots.
Used to build the Scout Carrier, Frigate, Khamir, Hive Carrier, Seeker, Leech, Spinelayer, Scarab, and Tiamat.
Unit Dependency: Warlord Training Grounds.
Required for: Bio Forge and Mutation Colony.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PLANTATION
entries.value:
Construct PLANTATION
Requires 2 slots.

Resupplies ships and gun platforms within limited radius.

Unit Dependency: Thripid.
Required for: Dissection Chamber, Zorap, Greater Plantation evolution, Supply Upgrades (lvl 1-3), Resupply Upgrades (lvl 1-3).
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_DISSECTION
entries.value:
Construct DISSECTION CHAMBER
Requires 2 slots.

Salvages ships for 100% original investment.

Unit Dependency: Plantation.
Required for: Tiamat.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_BLASTFURNACE
entries.value:
Construct BLAST FURNACE
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Weapon (lvl 1-2).

Unit Dependency: Thripid.
Required for: Frigate, Khamir, Explosives Range evolution.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_EXPLORANGE
entries.value:
EXPLOSIVES RANGE
Takes up 1 slot.
Used to research Weapon Upgrades (lvl1- 3) and the Explosive Ram Upgrades (lvl 1-2).
Unit Dependency: Thripid.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_EYESTALK
entries.value:
Construct EYE STALK
Requires 2 slots.

Offers 15 command points. Clears fog of war and detects ships at long range. Researches Sensor (lvl 1-3). 

Unit Dependency: Cocoon.
Required for: Seeker, Mutation Colony evolution.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_BIOFORGE
entries.value:
Construct BIO FORGE
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Shield (lvl 1-2) to increase shields of ships. 

Unit Dependency: Niad.
Required for: Tiamat, Fusion Mill evolution, Carapace Plant evolution.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FUSIONMILL
entries.value:
FUSION MILL
Takes up 1 slot.
Used to research Engine Upgrades (lvl 1-2) to increase all ships' speed.
Can evolve into the Hybrid Center.
Unit Dependency: Bio Forge.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_CARAPACE
entries.value:
CARAPACE PLANT
Takes up 1 slot.
Used to research Hull Upgrades (lvl 1-2) to increase the hull of all ships and platforms, except the Seeker.
Can evolve into the Hybrid Center.
Unit Dependency: Bio Forge.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HYBRID
entries.value:
HYBRID CENTER
Takes up 1 slot.
Used to upgrade speed, shield, and hull of all ships by researching Engine Upgrades (lvl 3), Shield Upgrades (lvl 3), and Hull Upgrades (lvl 3) .
Unit Dependency: Fusion Mill or the Carapace Plant.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_CARRIONROOST
entries.value:
Construct CARRION ROOST
Requires 2 slots.

Researches Fighter Wing (lvl 1-5) to increase fighter accuracy to enemies.

Unit Dependency: Warlord Training Grounds.
Required for: Plasma Hive, Hive Carrier, Tiamat.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PLASMASPITTER
entries.value:
Construct PLASMA SPITTER
Floats in space.

Defensive platform that fires a small plasma bolt. Automatically attacks enemy units. 

Unit Dependency: Warlord Training Grounds.
Required for: Plasma Hive evolution, Voraak Cannon evolution.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PLASMAHIVE
entries.value:
PLASMA HIVE

Constructed in space.
Defensive platform that launches wings of fighters for long range attacks. Automatically attacks enemy ships and platforms.
Unit Dependency: Carrion Roost and Plasma Spitter.
Armor: Medium .

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_VORAAK
entries.value:
VORAAK CANNON

Constructed in space.
Defensive platform that fires a large plasma bolt. Automatically attacks enemy ships and platforms. 
Causes heavy damage at long range.
Unit Dependency: Mutation Colony and Plasma Spitter.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_WEEVER
entries.value:
Construct WEAVER

Only Mantis ship that can build and repair platforms as well as salvage platforms. The salvage value is 50% of the total cost of the platform.

Unit Dependency: Cocoon.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_ZORAP
entries.value:
Construct ZORAP

Resupplies ships within limited radius.

Unit Dependency: Cocoon, Collector, Plantation.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SIPHON
entries.value:
Construct SIPHON

Harvests ore from asteroid and debris fields and gas from nebulae. Increase its holding capacity by researching Siphon (lvl 1-3) at Collector. 

Unit Dependency: Collector.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FRIGATE
entries.value:
Construct FRIGATE

Small, fast gunboat that fires twin laser blasts from its front turrets. Good for scouting and in close battles, but weak against larger ships.

Unit Dependency: Thripid, Blast Furnace.
Main Weapon: Twin laser turrets.
Special Ability: Mimic.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SCOUTCARRIER
entries.value:
Construct SCOUT CARRIER

Medium ship that launches attack fighters to attack enemies from short- to medium-range distance. Good against light-armored units.

Unit Dependency: Thripid.
Main Weapon: 1 squad of light attack fighters.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_KHAMIR
entries.value:
Construct KHAMIR

Small ship with excellent speed that fires a single laser dart.

Unit Dependency: Thripid, Blast Furnace.
Main Weapon: Single action dart laser.
Special Ability: Explosive Ram.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SPINELAYER
entries.value:
Construct SPINELAYER

Small ship with medium speed that drops mines for defensive purposes.

Unit Dependency: Niad, Explosives Range.
Main Weapon: None.
Special Ability: Cloaked mines.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LEECH
entries.value:
Construct LEECH

Carries troops to infiltrate construction ships, harvesting ships, and platforms (not gunboats). Research Leech (lvl 1-2) at Warlord Training Grounds to take over more heavily armored units. 

Unit Dependency: Niad, Hybrid Center.
Main Weapon: None.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HIVECARRIER
entries.value:
Construct HIVE CARRIER

Large ship with medium speed that launches 2 squads of attack fighters from medium- to long-range distance.

Unit Dependency: Thripid, Carrion Roost.
Main Weapon: 2 squads of medium attack fighters.
Special Weapon: Repellent Cloud.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SCARAB
entries.value:
Construct SCARAB

Large ship that fires plasma bolts from its twin plasma launchers. Provides excellent protection for long-range attack fighters.

Unit Dependency: Niad, Carapace Plant.
Main Weapon: Twin plasma launchers.
Special Weapon: Gravity Well.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TIAMAT
entries.value:
Construct TIAMAT

Large ship that unleashes devastating damage from its 3 squads of heavy attack fighters launched from long range.

Unit Dependency: Niad, Carrion Roost, Bio Forge, Dissection Chamber.
Main Weapon: 3 squads of heavy attack fighters.
Special Weapon: Repulsor Wave.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_CLOAK
entries.value:
Research CLOAKING

Research MIMIC

Special ability of the Frigate. When used, the Frigate transforms into a replica of the targeted enemy ship. Can remain transformed until supplies are depleted.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_REPELLCLOUD
entries.value:
Research REPELLENT CLOUD

Special weapon of the Hive Carrier. When released, the cloud quickly spreads, causing speed reduction to ships caught in its path. Visibility is extremely limited until the cloud begins to dissipate.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_GRAVWELL
entries.value:
Research GRAVITY WELL

Special weapon of the Scarab. When fired, a torpedo explodes, immobilizing all ships caught within the fallout radius. Ships are invulnerable and immobilized by a temporary gravity pull caused by the torpedo's blast.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_REPULSEBEAM
entries.value:
Research REPULSOR WAVE

Special weapon of the Tiamat. When discharged, the Tiamat emits a wave of energy in order to keep its distance from enemy attacks. This allows the Tiamat to effectively utilize its long-range heavy fighters while remaining a safe distance from enemy attackers.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_EVOLUTION_GRCOLLECTOR
entries.value:
Evolve into GREATER COLLECTOR
Requires same 3 slots.

Harvests ore/gas faster than Collector; increases maximum crew capacity. Builds Siphons; researches any remaining upgrades from Collector.

Unit Dependency: Collector, Mutation Colony.
Storage Capacity: 1500 ore, 750 gas,100 crew.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_EVOLUTION_NIAD
entries.value:
Evolve into NIAD
Requires same 3 slots.

Builds Scout Carriers, Frigates, Khamirs, Hive Carriers, Seekers, Leeches, Spinelayers, Scarabs, Tiamats.

Unit Dependency: Thripid, Warlord Training Grounds.
Required for: Bio Forge, Mutation Colony.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_EVOLUTION_EXPLORANGE
entries.value:
Evolve into EXPLOSIVES RANGE 
Requires same 1 slot.
Researches any remaining upgrades from Blast Furnace, Weapon (lvl 3), and Explosive Ram (lvl 1-2).

Unit Dependency: Blast Furnace, Thripid.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_EVOLUTION_MUTACOLONY
entries.value:
Evolve into MUTATION COLONY
Requires same 2 slots.

Offers 15 command points. Researches Mimic, Repellent Cloud, Gravity Well, Repulsor Wave.

Unit Dependency: Eye Stalk, Niad.
Required for: Voraak Cannon, Greater Collector.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_EVOLUTION_FUSION
entries.value:
Evolve into FUSION MILL
Requires same 1 slot.

Researches Engine (lvl 1-2) to increase speed of ships. Can evolve into Hybrid Center.

Unit Dependency: Bio Forge.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_EVOLUTION_CARAPACE
entries.value:
Evolve into CARAPACE PLANT
Requires same 1 slot.

Researches Hull (lvl 1-2) to increase maximum hull points of ships and platforms, except Seeker. Can evolve into Hybrid Center.

Unit Dependency: Bio Forge.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_EVOLUTION_HYBRID
entries.value:
Evolve into HYBRID CENTER
Requires same 1 slot.

Researches any remaining upgrades from Bio Forge, Fusion Mill, and Carapace plant and Engine (lvl 3), Shield (lvl 3), and Hull (lvl 3).

Unit Dependency: Fusion Mill or Carapace Plant.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_EVOLUTION_PLASMAHIVE
entries.value:
Evolve into PLASMA HIVE 
Floats in space.

Defensive platform that launches wings of fighters for long-range attacks. Automatically attacks enemy units.

Unit Dependency: Carrion Roost, Plasma Spitter.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_EVOLUTION_VORAAK
entries.value:
Evolve into VORAAK CANNON
Floats in space.

Defensive platform that fires a large plasma bolt. Automatically attacks enemy units. Causes heavy damage at long range.

Unit Dependency: Mutation Colony, Plasma Spitter.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_ACROPOLIS
entries.value:
Construct ACROPOLIS
Requires 3 slots.

Offers 25 command points. Resupplies ships and gun platforms within limited radius. Builds Forgers, Stratums.

Unit Dependency: None.
Required for: Oxidator, Sentinel Tower, Jump Gate.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_OXIDATOR
entries.value:
Construct OXIDATOR
Requires 3 slots.

Harvests ore/gas. Builds Galiots; researches Supply (lvl 1-5), Resupply (lvl 1-2), Galiot (lvl 1-2), Gas (lvl 1-3), Ore (lvl 1-3). 

Unit Dependency: Acropolis.
Required for: Pavilion, Bunker.
Storage Capacity: 1500 ore, 1500 gas.
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_SENTINEL
entries.value:
Construct SENTINEL TOWER
Requires 2 slots. 

Offers 10 command points. Clears fog of war and detects ships at long range. Researches Sensor (lvl 1-5).

Unit Dependency: Acropolis.
Required for: ESP Coil, Helion Veil, Pavilion, Oracle.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PAVILION
entries.value:
Construct PAVILION
Requires 3 slots.

Builds Taoses, Polarises, Auroras, Legionnaires, Oracles.

Unit Dependency: Oxidator, Sentinel Tower.
Required for: Greater Pavilion, Proteus, Eutromil.
Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_BUNKER
entries.value:
Construct BUNKER
Requires 1 slot.

Recruits crew from earth and swamp planets. Researches Legionnaire (lvl 1-4). 

Unit Dependency: Oxidator.
Required for: Citadel, Legionnaire.
Storage Capacity: 200 crew.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_HELIONVEIL
entries.value:
Construct HELION VEIL
Requires 1 slot.

Researches Shield (lvl 1-5) to increase shields of ships. 

Unit Dependency: Sentinel Tower.
Required for: Aurora. 
Armor: Heavy.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_ESPCOIL
entries.value:
Construct ESP COIL
Floats in space.

Defense platform that detects units from long range and discharges an electrically charged arc at enemy units.

Unit Dependency: Sentinel Tower.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_CITADEL
entries.value:
Construct CITADEL
Requires 2 slots.

Recruits crew faster than Bunker. 
(Builds Magistrates Blanus, Elan, Vivac, Joule, Procyo, Natus in Quick Battle and Multiplayer Games). 
Unit Dependency: Bunker; Required for: Xeno Chamber, Polaris, Legionnaire Upgrades (lvl 1-2).
Storage Capacity: 300 crew; Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_EUTROMIL
entries.value:
Construct EUTROMIL
Requires 2 slots.

Resupplies and repairs ships, as well as those of allies, within limited radius. Resupplies gun platforms.

Unit Dependency: Pavilion.
Required for: Stratum, Supply Upgrades (lvl 1-5), Resupply Upgrade (lvl 1).
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_GRPAVILION
entries.value:
Construct GREATER PAVILION
Requires 3 slots.

Unit Dependency: Pavilion.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PROTEUS

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_XENO

Armor: Medium.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_STARBURST

Unit Dependency: Munitions Annex, Turbine Dock.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_PORTAL
entries.value:
Construct PORTAL
Floats in space.

Creates a wormhole into any visible system on the system map. Build the Portal, select it, and right-click an explored system on the sector map. Most ships within the region of the Portal will warp into the system, and the Portal will dissipate.

Unit Dependency: Xeno Chamber.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_TAOS
entries.value:
Construct TAOS

Small, fast gunboat that carries a small laser beam to fend off carrier fighters. Good against light- and unarmored units.

Unit Dependency: Pavilion.
Main Weapon: Small laser beam.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_FORGER
entries.value:
Construct FORGER
Only Celareon ship that can build and repair platforms as well as salvage platforms. The salvage value is 50% of the total cost of the platform.

Unit Dependency: Acropolis.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_STRATUM

Construct STRATUM
Resupplies ships within limited radius.

Unit Dependency: Acropolis, Eutromil.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_GALIOT
entries.value:

Unit Dependency: Oxidator.
Armor: Light.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_ORACLE
entries.value:
Construct ORACLE

Small ship with excellent speed and large sensor radius. Can cloak itself to hide from enemy units. Can also ping a system to track down units. Excellent for recon in unexplored systems.

Unit Dependency: Pavilion, Sentinel Tower.
Main Weapon: None.
Special Ability: Cloaking, Ping.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_AURORA

Unit Dependency: Pavilion, Helion Veil, Greater Pavilion.

Special Ability: Shroud.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_BUILD_LEGIONAIRE

Unit Dependency: Pavilion, Bunker.
Main Weapon: Troops.
Armor: None.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_TEXT_ORE
entries.value: Ore is smelted to make the metals you need to build ships, platforms,and weaponry. It is found on earth planets and moons and in asteroid and debris fields. The hardware-happy Terrans have the greatest need for ore.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_TEXT_GAS
entries.value: Gas is harvested from earth planets, gas giants, and nebulae.  Among the three races, the technology-driven Celareons are the most reliant on gas.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_TEXT_CREW
entries.value: Crew are the men and women who will do or die at your command.  They exist only on earth and swamp planets.   You need crew to run your ships. The carrier-reliant Mantis, who burn through drones like jet fuel, have the greatest need for crew.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_TEXT_CP
entries.value: As you expand your base, you will accumulate command points, which mark the ability to command a ship. Some ships and platforms require more command points to construct them than other units. You will have to be aware at all times of how many command points you can afford to spend.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_TEXT_DISABLED
entries.value:
This system needs to be IN SUPPLY in order to have this unit function. For a system to be IN SUPPLY you need to have a HEADQUARTERS (or a COCOON or an ACROPOLIS) built in this system or be connected by a JUMPGATE to a system has a HEADQUARTERS  (or a COCOON or an ACROPOLIS). 
 
Harvesting platforms can continue to harvest Ore, Gas, & Crew off planets regardless of a system being IN or  OUT of Supply.

The Aegis Shield is the special weapon of the Dreadnought.  When activated, the Dreadnought will become invincible to all enemy attacks.  The downside of this shield is the amount of supplies it costs to keep the shield activated.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_MIMIC
entries.value:
MIMIC

The Mimic is the special weapon of the Frigate.  When used, the Frigate is transformed into a replica of the targeted enemy ship. Can remain transformed until supplies are depleted.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_REPELLCLOUD
entries.value:
REPELLENT CLOUD

The Repellent Cloud is the special weapon of the Hive Carrier. When released, the cloud quickly spreads out causing damage to the hulls of ships caught in its path of destruction. Visibility is extremely limited until the cloud begins to dissipate.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_GRAVWELL
entries.value:
GRAVITY WELL

The Gravity Well is the special weapon of the Scarab.  When fired, a torpedo explodes immobilizing all ships caught within the fallout radius.  The ships are immobilized by a temporary gravity pull caused from the torpedo's blast.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_REPULSEWAVE
entries.value:
REPULSOR WAVE

The Repulsor Wave is the special weapon of the Tiamat.  When discharged, the Tiamat emits a wave of energy in order to keep its distance from enemy attacks.  This allows the Tiamat to effectively utilize its long-range heavy fighters while remaining a safe distance from enemy attackers.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_RAM
entries.value:
EXPLOSIVE RAM

The Explosive  Ram is the special weapon of the Khamir.  When the explosive ram is activated and a target is selected the Khamir will propell itself at a high velocity and explode upon impact causing heavy damage.  There are 2 levels to this special weapon.  Each level increases the amount of damage the Explosive Ram will cause.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_SYNTHESIS
entries.value:
SYNTHESIS
Used by the Taos, it merges into another ship, transferring its hull points to the targeted ship.  If you have a weakened ship that is more important, there would be a moment where the Taos will give the hit points it has and transfer them over to another ship.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_DISRUPTOR
entries.value:
MASS DISRUPTOR
This is the special weapon of the Polaris.  When this weapon hits an enemy unit, the enemy unit will lose 25% of its total hull points.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_SHROUD
entries.value:
SHROUD
The Shroud is the special weapon of the Aurora.  This special weapon will allow the Aurora and another ship invisible.  Only units that have cloak-detecting technology can see these ships (Infiltrator, Seeker, Oracle).To un-Shroud click on the Cloak icon.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_DESTABILIZE
entries.value:
DESTABILIZER TORPEDO
This weapon of the Trireme paralyzes a number of ships within a radius at which you fired. The affected ships will spin in an uncontrollable fashion and cannot be given orders until the effect wears off.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_AUGERRAY
entries.value:
AUGER RAY
This is a special weapon of the Monolith that causes massive damage to an enemy ship.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_SPECIAL_AD_CLOAKS
entries.value:
CLOAKING 

Cloaking is the special ability of the Aurora and Oracle.  This special ability will allow the Aurora and Oracle to become invisible.  Only units that have cloak-detecting technology can see these ships (Infiltrator, Seeker, Oracle).  Cloaking technology is only supply costing to the Aurora.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_ADMIRAL_FORMFLEET
entries.value:
FORM FLEET 
 
To form a fleet, select the fleet admiral and all
the units you want in a fleet, and then click the Form Fleet
button. A ship may only be in one fleet at a time. To select this
fleet, click the ship that the admiral is on, or click the Fleets hot
button to cycle through all your fleets. 
 
 A Fleet can be assigned to a function key (F1-F6) for quick access by first selecting your fleet and then [Ctrl] + a function key.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_ADMIRAL_DISBANDFLEET
entries.value:
DISBAND FLEET 
 
To disband a fleet, select it, and then click the Disband Fleet button. The fleet is immediately dis-banded and the fleet admiral returns to his individual ship.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_ADMIRAL_REPAIR
entries.value:
REPAIR FLEET 
 
To repair an entire fleet, select it, and then click the Repair Fleet button. The fleet immediately goes to the nearest Repair Platform, and all damaged units are repaired.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_ADMIRAL_RESUPPLY
entries.value:
RESUPPLY FLEET 
 
To resupply an entire fleet, select it, and then click the Resupply Fleet button. The fleet immediately goes to the nearest Supply Platform, and all units are resupplied.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_ADMIRAL_TRANSFER
entries.value:
TRANSFER ADMIRAL 
 
To transfer an admiral to another ship without disbanding the fleet, select the fleet, click the Transfer Admiral button, and then click the ship you want him to board when the cursor becomes a flag.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_ADMIRAL_ASSAULT
entries.value:
TROOPSHIP ASSAULT 
 
To assault an enemy with a Troopship in a fleet, select the fleet, click the Troopship Assault button, and then right-click the target when the cursor becomes an orange, partial crosshairs icon.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_ATEASE
entries.value:
AT EASE Formation 
 
 This the default formation.  Ships are grouped loosely.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_ASSAULT
entries.value:
STANDARD ASSAULT Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Light and Medium armored ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types that are not assigned to a group.

All ships within the formation will recieve a bonus to weapon damage and supplies.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_BLOCKADE
entries.value:
BLOCKADE Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Light and Medium armored ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types that are not assigned to a group.

All ships within the formation will recieve a bonus to sensors, weapon damage and defense.

All ships within the formation will also recieve a penalty bonus to speed, weapon range, supplies, and damage vs. platforms.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_CONVOY
entries.value:
CONVOY Formation 
 
 This formation consists of a main group. The The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types.

All ships within the formation will recieve a bonus to speed.

All ships within the formation will also recieve a penalty bonus to sensors, weapon range, weapon damage, defense, and supplies.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_HALSEY
entries.value:
HALSEY Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, battery groups, a recon group, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Medium and Heavy armored ships. The Battery group consists of carriers. The Recon group consists of light armored ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types that are not assigned to a group.

Battleships, Fleet Carriers, and Dreadnoughts within the formation will recieve a bonus to alltech.

All ships within the formation will also recieve a penalty bonus to sensors, weapon range, and supplies.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_LANCER
entries.value:
LANCER Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Short and Medium ranged ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and all other ship types that are not assigned to a group.

Lancer Cruisers within the formation will recieve a bonus to weapon range, weapon damage, defense, damage vs. Light and Medium armored ships.

All ships within the formation will receive a penalty bonus to speed and supplies.

entries.name: IDS_HINT_FORM_PLANETDEF
entries.value:
PLANET DEFENSE Formation 
 
 This formation consists of strike groups, a main group, and a support group. The Strike group consists of Short and Medium ranged ships. The Support group consists of Repairships, Supplyships, and Civillian ships.  The Main group consists of the Admiral and long ranged ships. 
 
 This formation generates an AoE that buffs platforms. Platforms affected by this formation receive a bonus to defense. 
 
 All ships within the formation will receive a bonus to weapon damage and a penalty bonus to speed and supplies.
